To determine how many days before the deadline Mike will finish his reading, we follow these steps:

1.  **Calculate the number of days required to read the book:**
    Mike needs to read a total of 200 pages. He plans to read 10 pages per day.
    $$ \text{Days to finish} = \frac{\text{Total Pages}}{\text{Pages per Day}} = \frac{200}{10} = 20 \text{ days} $$

2.  **Determine the deadline:**
    The assignment must be completed within 30 days.

3.  **Calculate the difference between the deadline and the time taken:**
    Subtract the number of days Mike needs to finish from the total number of days allowed.
    $$ \text{Days before deadline} = \text{Deadline} - \text{Days to finish} $$
    $$ \text{Days before deadline} = 30 - 20 = 10 \text{ days} $$

Mike will finish his reading 10 days before the deadline.

Final answer: 10
